name: Complex_Evaluate_1
questiontext: Given that \(z\) is the complex number \[{{CT:0}},\] evaluate the modulus and the principal value of the argument of \({{CT:1}}\). Give your answers in the correct order i.e. \([r,\theta]\) [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback: Let \(r_1\) be the modulus of \(z\) and \(\theta_1\) be the argument. Then \[r_1=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}=\sqrt{\left({{CT:2}}\right)^2+\left({{CT:3}}\right)^2}=\sqrt{{CT:4}}={{CT:5}},\] and \[\tan(\theta_1)=\frac{{CT:3}}{{CT:2}}={{CT:6}}, \] giving \[\theta_1={{CT:7}}.\] Therefore for \({{CT:1}}\)\[r = r_1^{{CT:8}}={{CT:5}}^{{CT:8}}={{CT:9}},\ \] and, \[\theta={{CT:8}}\cdot \theta_1={{CT:8}}\cdot {{CT:7}}={{CT:10}},\ \] and the principal argument is \[\theta={{CT:11}}\]
